run_finetune_video: run the finetune_video.py module to fine-tune a video classification model on UCF101 or HMDB51
create_finetune_model: create a Finetune_Model wrapping a base architecture with a classifier head for video classification
train_video_model: train a video classification model with SGD or Adam optimizer and cross-entropy loss
evaluate_video_model: evaluate a video classification model and aggregate clip-level predictions to video-level accuracy
parse_finetune_args: parse command-line arguments for dataset, model architecture, training hyperparameters, and logging options
